verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-endpoint reference pages (e.g. schedule-call) and a downloadable OpenAPI spec that can be imported into Postman. Nothing documents an interactive, in-browser API reference with runnable examples or a try-it playground. Postman import is a user-side workaround, and the OpenAPI spec is a building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
